summary: Verified the Inventory category read-time-join fix (inventory_service.get_cached_inventory now re-joins live category from component_master on every read). Backend: curl-confirmed PATCH /api/admin/components/SI-0038C-2 category 'Steel'->'Hardware' and back is immediately reflected in GET /api/inventory with zero refresh. Frontend (Playwright): Admin page category dropdown changed SI-0038C-2 from 'Hardware' to 'Steel' (toast 'SI-0038C-2 set to "Steel"' shown, Source column showed 'Manual'), then navigated straight to Inventory page (no Refresh/Resolve/Categorize click) and searched the same product_id - row immediately showed category='Steel'. Reverted back to 'Hardware' via API afterward to restore prior test state. Regression: Inventory category filter (Hardware -> 642/3176 items), site filter (RADISH TECHNOLOGIES -> 52 items), search, pagination (Next: Showing 51-100 of 3176) all work correctly; Items in Stock/Total On-Hand Qty/Total Inventory Value stats update correctly per filter and are unaffected by the fix. 'Categorize All' button still works end-to-end - completed instantly (idempotent) with toast '305 top-level item(s) set to Finished Goods, 0 classified by AI, out of 3176 total.' No regressions found.
critical_code_review_comments: get_cached_inventory's read-time join against component_master (batched find with $in) is efficient and correctly scoped - only queries category for product_ids already in the cached snapshot, no N+1 queries.

categorize-all endpoint's redundant manual cache-patch code removal is safe since the universal read-time join in get_cached_inventory now covers this case; confirmed via UI that Categorize All still completes and reports correct counts.
Good defensive comment/docstring updates explaining why category is re-joined on every read instead of trusted from the snapshot.
